نبذة

Located in DIFC Dubai and connected to Gate Avenue, our salon offers a full range of hair and beauty services. From cuts, colors, and treatments to waxing, threading, lash extensions, and nail care, we have everything to meet your beauty needs. We work with top brands like Kevin Murphy, L’Oréal, Dyson, OPI, and more to deliver exceptional results. Complimentary consultations are available to help you achieve your perfect look.

Copper Beauty Salon is defined by attentive hair care, with stylists praised for understanding individual hair needs and delivering polished results. Clients appreciate thoughtful colour advice, precise cut and finish services, and careful blow-dries, alongside a warm, professional team that helps each visit feel comfortable and leaves them happy with their hair.
